title: OmniPrep™ For High Quality Genomic DNA Extraction From Cultured Cells
author: G-Biosciences
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.e5xbg7n
materials: Allow the sample to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Lyse cells in Genomic Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Transfer 1–5 × 10⁶ cells (suspension, trypsinized, or directly on plate) into a 1.5 mL microfuge tube (or keep on plate) and add 500 µL Genomic Lysis Buffer. Gently pipette up and down several times to release nuclei, then transfer the lysate to a clean tube.

steps.title: Incubate lysate at 55–60 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the lysate at 55–60 °C for 15 minutes (do not exceed 60 °C).

steps.title: Optional Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: For maximum DNA recovery, add 1 µL Proteinase K solution per 100 µL Lysis Buffer, then incubate at 60 °C for 1–2 hours, inverting the tube periodically each hour.

steps.title: Extract with chloroform
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL chloroform to the lysate and mix by inverting the tube several times.

steps.title: Phase separation by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 10 minutes; carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase to a clean microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add DNA Stripping Solution
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL DNA Stripping Solution to the aqueous phase and invert several times to mix.

steps.title: Incubate with stripping solution
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 60 °C for 5–10 minutes.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with precipitation solution
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Precipitation Solution and invert several times. If a white precipitate does not form, add 50 µL aliquots of Precipitation Solution until it appears.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a clean tube, add 500 µL isopropanol, and invert the tube 10 times to precipitate DNA. (Optional) Add 2 µL Mussel Glycogen as a DNA carrier.

steps.title: Pellet DNA by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 5 minutes to pellet genomic DNA.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Ethanol wash of DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL 70 % ethanol, invert several times to wash the pellet, centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 1 minute, then decant or pipette off the ethanol. Invert the tube on a clean absorbent surface for several minutes to drain excess ethanol; avoid letting the pellet dry completely.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in TE buffer
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL TE Buffer to the pellet and incubate at room temperature for at least 15 minutes to rehydrate (incubation at 55–60 °C for 5–60 minutes can be used to speed rehydration).

steps.title: Optional RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL LongLife™ RNase per 100 µL TE Buffer (optional).

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store DNA at 4 °C for short‑term use; for long‑term storage keep at –20 °C or –80 °C. Typical yield is 0.2–1.5 µg DNA per 10⁶ cells.
